The sign Aquarius of the zodiac (also called कुम्भ).
Suspending the breath as a religious exercise.
A part of a column; स्तम्भं विभज्य नवधा वहनं भागो घटो$स्य भागो$न्यः Bṛi.
A peculiar form of a temple; Bṛi.
The head; 'घटः समाधिभेदे ना शिरः कूटकटेषु च' Medinī;
. -Comp. -आटोपः covering for a carriage or any article of furniture. -उदरः N. of Gaṇeśa; घटोदरः शूर्पकर्णो गणाध्यक्षो मदोत्कटः
. -उद्भवः, -जः, -योनिः, -संभवः epithets of the sage Agastya.-ऊधस् f. (forming घटोध्नी) a cow with a full udder; गाः कोटिशः स्पर्शयता घटोध्नीः

. -कञ्चुकि n. a rite practised by Tāntrikas and Śāktas (in which the bodices of different women are placed in a receptacle (घट) and the men present at the ceremony are allowed to take them out one by one and then cohabit with the woman to whom each bodice belongs); Āgamapr.
a piece of a broken jar, pot-sherd; जीयेय येन कविना यमकैः परेण तस्मै वहेयमुदकं घट- कर्परेण Ghāṭ.22. -कारः, -कृत् m. a potter; Bṛi.

;16.29. -ग्रहः a water-bearer. -दासी a procuress; cf. कुम्भदासी. -पर्यसनम् the ceremony of performing the funeral rites of a patita or apostate (who is unwilling to go back to his caste &c.) during his very life-time. -भवः, -योनिः Agastya. -भेदनकम् an instrument used in making pots. -राजः a water-jar of baked clay. -स्थापनम् placing a water-pot as a type of Durgā for nine days (नवरात्रम्).

A toll station. -Comp. -कुटी a toll station. ˚प्रभात- न्याय see under न्याय; Sarva.
a man of a mixed tribe; (वैश्यायां रजका- ज्जातः).
घाटः [ghāṭḥ] टा [ṭā] टिका [ṭikā], टा टिका [घट्-अच्] The back of the neck.
Exerting oneself, striving for; एते सत्पुरुषाः परार्थघटकाः स्वार्थं परित्यज्य ये
Forming a constituent part, constituent, component.
कः A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers.
A match-maker, an agent who ascertains genealogies and negotiates matrimonial alliances.
Accomplishment, bringing about, effecting; as in अघटितघटना; यन्माहात्म्यवशेन यान्ति घटनां कार्याणि निर्यन्त्रणाम् Rāj.
Joining, union, mixing or bringing together, combination; तप्तेन तप्तमयसा घटनाय योग्यं
Strife, hostility; इत्थं यत्र परिग्रहस्य घटना शम्भोरपि स्याद्गृहे
घट्टनम् [ghaṭṭanam], 1 Shaking, moving; सुप्तसर्प इव दण्डघट्टनाद्रोषितो$स्मि
Effecting, forming; प्रणयविघटनार्थं किं नु तद् घट्टनार्थम् Parṇāl 2.54.
A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes; मातङ्गघटा Śi.1.64.
A plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a clock.
लम्बिनी, one of the Mātṛis attending on Skanda;' स्त्रियां तु घण्टा- लम्बिन्योः Nm.
घटिकः [ghaṭikḥ], [घटेन तरति ठन्] A water-man. -कम् The hip, the posteriors.
घटिका [ghaṭikā], 1 A small water-jar, bucket, a small earthen vessel; नार्यः श्मशानघटिका इव वर्जनीयाः
A measure of time equal to 24 minutes.
A water-pot used in calculating the Ghaṭikās of the day;
The ankle.-Comp. -मण्डलम् the equatorial circle. -यन्त्रम् See घटीयन्त्र.
. -ता A particular way of beating a drum.
घटिन् [ghaṭin], m. The sign Aquarius of the zodiac (also called कुम्भ).
घटिंधम [ghaṭindhama], a. One who blows into a water-jar or pot. -मः A potter.
घटिंधय [ghaṭindhaya], a. One who drinks a pitcherful (of water &c.).
A measure of time equal to 24 minutes.
A small water-pot used in calculating the Ghaṭikās or time of the day; घटी चेटी विटः किं स्विज्जानात्यमरकामिनीम् Udb. -Comp. -कारः a potter. -ग्रह, -ग्राह a. See घटग्रह.
यन्त्रम् a machine for raising water (largely used in India), the rope and bucket of a well; see अरघट्ट, घटीयन्त्रगुणोपमः (हारः)
a contrivance (like a clepsydra) to ascertain the ghaṭikās or time of the day.
घटोत्कचः [ghaṭōtkacḥ], N. of a son of Bhīma by a female demon named हिडिम्बा;

-31. He was a very powerful person and fought valiantly in the great war between the Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas on the side of the former, but was slain by Karṇa with the Śakti or missile he had received from Indra; cf.
. The derivation of the name is given in the आदिपर्व of महाभारत as follows: घटो हास्योत्कच
To be busy with, strive after, exert oneself for, be intently occupied with anything (with inf. loc., or dat.); घटस्व ज्ञातिभिः सह
To happen, take place, be possible; प्राणैस्तपोभि- रथवा$भिमतं मदीयैः कृत्यं घटेत सुहृदो यदि तत्कृतं स्यात्
if it can be effected; कस्यापरस्योडुमयैः प्रसूनैर्वादित्रसृष्टि- र्घटते भटस्य
To be united with; दुर्दर्शनेन घटतामियमप्यनेन
To unite, join, bring together; इत्थं नारीर्घटयितुमलं कामिभिः Śi.9.87; अनेन भैमीं घटयिष्यतस्तथा
; क्रुधा संधिं भीमो विघटयति यूयं घटयत
To bring or place near to, bring in contact with, put on; घटयति घनं कण्ठाश्लेषे रसान्न पयोधरौ
To accomplish, bring about, effect; तटस्थः स्वानर्थान् घटयति च मौनं च भजते
To form, fashion, shape, work out, make; एवमभिधाय वैनतेयं ... अघटयत्
To prompt, impel; स्नेहौघो घटयति मां तथापि वक्तुम्
To unite, join, bring or collect together.
To shake, stir about; as in वायुघट्टिता लताः
To touch, rub, rub the hands over; विटजननखघट्टितेव वीणा
To disturb; प्रावर्त- येतां संग्रामं घट्टिताविव पन्नगौ
A means of livelihood, practice, business, profession.
घाटणम् [ghāṭaṇam], A bolt; अन्तर्वापि बहिर्वापि घाटणं कीलसंयुतम्
